_note: Every threshold the drift checks use, with its basis. This file's bytes are hashed into the run fingerprint, so changing a value is a config change, never a silent re-scoring of old runs.

hard_alarm_min.basis: assumption: one hard contract breach in a run can be transient; two is a pattern

hard_rate.basis: assumption: PRD section 10 asks for 100 percent schema validity; 5 percent is the largest breach rate a reviewer can still absorb by hand

alarm_per_run.basis: rule of three: one refusal at n=14 has a 21 percent upper bound, so a single event is not evidence; two in one run are

clean_calls_for_rate.basis: rule of three: 0 events in 60 clean calls bounds the rate at 5 percent (3/60); below that the per-run count rule applies

binomial_tail.basis: assumption: alarm when P(X >= k | n, 3/n_base) is under 1 percent

min_n.basis: assumption: below 10 findings the binomial limits are wider than the chart

min_shared.basis: assumption: fewer than 20 shared images cannot separate a 10-point move from noise

u_delta_watch.basis: 95 percent CI half-width on a proportion near 0.3 at n=50 is about 13 points

collapse_points.basis: assumption: U down and S0 up by 10 points each is the abstention-collapse signature

moved2_block.basis: D-004: the contract's +/-1 band makes a 2-level move outside declared uncertainty; 3 of 50 blocks promotion

dead_min_damaged.basis: runs/dev_gate02: 0 of 12 ir_solar routed; rule of three puts the recall upper bound at 3/8 with 8 damaged

template_ratio.basis: dev_gate02 ir_solar: 3 distinct reasons over 12 rows = 0.25; 0.5 leaves room for honest repetition

template_min_rows.basis: assumption: below 10 rows a low distinct-reason ratio is expected

fallback_alarm.basis: assumption: one laptop-GPU timeout per run is expected; two is a serving problem

inert_min_rows.basis: dev_gate02: 47 of 50 confidences at 0.95 or 0.98, nothing below 0.7; needs about 30 rows to say the threshold has no effect

upward_share.basis: FHWA: inspectors agree within one point 68 percent of the time, so 20 percent over 30 decisions would block on ordinary disagreement; half of overrides going up is under-grading

min_overrides.basis: assumption: direction over fewer than 10 overrides is noise

rolling_window.basis: assumption: 30 decisions is one reviewer session

agreement_watch.basis: FHWA 68 percent within-one across inspectors, rounded

reviewer_spread.basis: assumption: a reviewer 25 points from the others with n>=20 each is a calibration problem, not a model problem

critical_miss_block.basis: zero baseline: first S4 miss alarms, two within 100 decisions block the fingerprint

tokens_ratio.basis: runs/ui_0925_0856: $0.0567 per grade call; 1.5x output tokens is where that cost line stops holding

seconds_ratio.basis: UI states 10 to 40 s per grade; 2x the baseline median breaches it

null_gsd_delta.basis: MBEI and PV rubrics force U when GSD or irradiance is missing, so a 30-point change in null share moves the U rate by itself

below_256_share.basis: research note R03: 82.6 percent label flips under resolution change

min_frame_gap_s.basis: assumption: frames closer than 1 s from one video are near-duplicates

tail.basis: assumption: alarm when P(X >= k | 12, f0) is under 2 percent; at f0=1/12 that is k>=4

n_repeats.basis: assumption: three repeats per image bound the noise floor at about $2.38 (42 calls at $0.0567)

within_one_margin.basis: SE of a proportion at n about 40 per class is about 7 points; 5 is the smallest margin that can be reasoned about

recall_margin.basis: a gate miss is a skipped inspection and eval_v1 has more damaged images, so recall gets the tighter margin

u_margin.basis: assumption: U may rise 10 points before it costs more reviewer time than it saves

usd_ratio.basis: assumption: a quarter more per image is the budget line

min_n.basis: assumption: below 20 assessed images per class the comparison is insufficient_n

config.basis: one call is enough to check model identity

ops.basis: one call is the cold start; medians need a second
